scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const routes = ['inicio', 'orcamento', 'orcamentos', 'resumo', 'sucesso', 'portfolio', 'produtora']; if(fs.existsSync('dist/index.html')) { fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html'); routes.forEach(r => { fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/' + r + '.html'); const dir = 'dist/' + r; if(!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', dir + '/index.html'); }); }"
